purpose: Preliminary development test of Self-Noise Negative Guidance (SNNG), SNR-Compensated Guidance (SCG), SNR-Wiener Conditioning (SWC) and the antithetic student pair at the Step-4 handover

methods.snng: v = v_c + gamma (v_c - v_u) + eta (v_c - v_noise); noise-only prompt = the 20% quietest prompt frames tiled; teacher to Step 4 with this velocity, then the usual student
methods.anti: student with eps and with -eps from the plain Step-4 endpoint; keep the output closer to the endpoint on generated frames
methods.scg: teacher to Step 4 with CFG scale gamma(S) = 2 * clip(G_CLEAN / max(A + B*S, G_FLOOR), 1, r_max); A, B fitted to g_4 against prompt SNR on the EXP-012 development signals (prompts < 30 dB, the same 60 speakers evaluated here; the fit uses no failure labels)
methods.swc: prompt frames of the teacher's and the student's conditioning multiplied (linear mel magnitude) by G = clip(1 - beta(S) N_b / M, G_MIN, 1), N_b = mean of the quietest 20% prompt frames per band; beta(S) = beta_max * clip((30 - S) / 10, 0, 1)
methods.enh: prompt cleaned by the pretrained DNS64 Demucs enhancer (pip denoiser 0.1.5) before conditioning, mixed wet*enhanced + (1-wet)*noisy; enh4/enh6: wet 1 at Steps 4/6; enhs4: wet = clip((30 - S)/10, 0, 1) at Step 4; the router SNR is that of the unenhanced prompt; enhancer time is recorded (enh_ms) and not counted in NFE
methods.piec: generated frames of the final mel multiplied (linear magnitude) by G = clip(1 - beta(S) N_b / M, 0.1, 1), N_b = mean of the quietest 20% prompt frames per band of the noisy conditioning; beta(S) = clip((30 - S) / 10, 0, 1); piec4 on the plain Step-4 output, swcpiec4 on the SWC Step-4 output
methods.controls: enh8 and piec8 are cleaned Step-8 outputs, used to judge enh4 and piec4 within the cleaned system; not candidates
methods.tas: Trajectory Anomaly Score: squared Mahalanobis distance of log(d_1..d_6) from the clean-prompt training mean (one-sided: only below the mean); hand over iff SNR >= 20 dB and score <= tau, tau certified by LTT; drift profile from the committed EXP-012 signals of the same cases

primary_test: each method vs plain Step 4 on the noisy conditions pooled (exact McNemar, two-sided)
criteria: C1 noisy Step-4 failures drop by at least 25% with p < 0.05
C2 clean Step-4 failures rise by at most 1
C3 pooled out-of-fold <m>_route or <m>_heavy: lower mean NFE than snr_theta with no more failures
secondary: average SIM and WER vs Step 8, paired Wilcoxon, noisy and clean (descriptive)
selection_rule: among candidates (controls enh8 and piec8 excluded), the method passing the most criteria; ties broken by the lower pooled mean NFE of <m>_route or <m>_heavy
